title: Choose the visual world — SODAX Terminal
question: The roll assigned Event Display. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Event Display
options.lineage: collider detector event displays — concentric rings, curved tracks, calorimeter wedges
options.thesis: The hub IS the beamline: every intent is one event, fanning from centre through rings of chains — the architecture diagram becomes the interface, refusing the stat-card dashboard entirely.
options.viewport: Full-bleed near-black. Sonic sits at centre as the beamline ring; the 12 spoke chains are concentric rings outward, each arc carrying that chain's reserves. Live orderbook intents render as curved tracks arcing source-ring → hub → destination-ring. The working surface (trade form, tables) docks right in the same grammar. Tabs become detector layers, not a rail.
options.risk: A concentric canvas can fight dense tabular work, and Operate mode forbids expression obscuring the task — the tables must stay real tables. WebGL/canvas at this track density has a real perf budget.

options.label: Segment Mask
options.lineage: seven-segment family — bedside clocks, gas-price totems, scoreboards
options.thesis: Every figure in the product is a segment readout, and the unlit ghost segments are designed as deliberately as the lit ones.
options.case: Fuses strongly: this audience lives on numeric readouts, and the price-totem/scoreboard lineage sidesteps Bloomberg cosplay cleanly. Costs: labels and forms need a second face, and its native law — instant segment swap, nothing slides — argues against the motion-forward brief you just picked.
options.viewport: A rigid mask of cells. Price totem stack for the market summary, four-digit readouts for health factor and APY, ghost cells holding every empty slot.
options.risk: A whole UI of segment glyphs is unreadable for prose and form labels; the mask only carries numbers.

options.label: Cyclorama
options.lineage: theatre cyclorama lighting — black night through cobalt and rose into white day
options.thesis: Market state is light state: the surface moves from depthless black through cobalt to full day as activity rises.
options.case: Fuses partly. The horizon-band composition is a genuinely fresh layout law for a dashboard and the cue-timeline maps to intent lifecycle. But it makes colour the sole carrier of state, which this product's own accessibility rule forbids, and PRODUCT.md warns against mood outranking data.
options.viewport: Content held in horizontal horizon bands stacked dark to light, lighting-plot stencil caps for labels, tabular numerals throughout.
options.risk: State-as-light needs a redundant non-colour signal bolted on, which is exactly where the concept starts to leak.

options.label: Billing Sheet
options.lineage: festival lineup poster — hierarchy by size and line break alone, no imagery
options.thesis: One face at eight sizes; magnitude is the only structure, so the biggest number on screen is the one that matters most.
options.case: Fuses poorly for the core task. Size-as-billing ranks 26 reserves by APY beautifully and would make a striking Earn screen — but a swap form is not a billing, and a terminal shows many simultaneous values rather than one ranked descent. It solves a quarter of the product.
options.viewport: One condensed face, saturated ground, single contrasting ink, long tail justified into a dense block at the foot.
options.risk: Trade and Portfolio have no honest mapping; you'd be running two design systems.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark DeFi dashboard every competitor ships — stat-card row, centred swap card, one accent — executed at a craft level none of them reach.
canonCard.viewport: Stat row across the top, swap card centred, reserve table below, wallet pill top-right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the category in a screenshot, which is the one thing the launch content needs it not to be.
